nom: Oak Essentials Pure Gel Face Cleanser

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser with safe & effective ingredientsGentle cleanser with safe & effective ingredients
avis.texte: First impression of this facial cleanser is obviously the bottle and packaging. The heavy glass container and the minimalistic design does point to this being a luxury product. You do have to be careful not to pick up the bottle by the lid. I did that once and the bottom dropped hard on my quartz countertops. Luckily, my countertops nor the bottle was damaged. I appreciate the safe and effective ingredients of this cleanser. It’s not a deep cleanser and gentle on the skin. It lathers really well and a little goes a long way. The instructions suggests “2-3 pumps” but I find one pump is plenty. The scent is very earthy. It smells like fresh leaves to me but in the best way. My skin feels cleansed but not stripped of its natural barrier when I use this. I really enjoy this cleanser and find it effective. I use this most days and then rotate with a deeper cleanser throughout the week. I’m still debating though if I’d repurchase given the price of it.

As part of the Oak Essentials line this cleanser focuses on clean, naturally effective formulas designed to support aging skin. The cleanser comes in a very nice container with an easy-to-use pump. The cleanser is slightly scented, which for me is neither a plus nor a minus. When I washed my face with the gel cleaner it had a nice foam that was refreshing, and I liked that my skin did not feel dry or excessively tight. What I like most is that it is formulated without harsh ingredients like sulfates, parabens, and phthalates and is loaded with ingredients like niacinamide to help brighten the skin. Aloe leaf juice to hydrate and help with calming dry, sensitive skin as well as Pro-vitamin B5 that helps with creating a visibly smoother and more even-looking skin tone, and carrot root extract that can help brighten and support cell turnover. For anyone with normal, oily, or blemish-prone skin looking for a gentle and effective daily cleanser, the Oak Essentials Clarifying Daily Cleanser provides a quality, clean solution. Skincare and the ingredients used can be subject to individual needs and skin type and sensitivities, but this blend of natural ingredients is known to soothe and hydrate, helping to keep skin feeling balanced and looking healthy over time. I think with any skincare product the key words should be “Over Time.” My experience from several washes is that my skin reacted positively and over time with consideration to the ingredient’s I feel my skin will have posit

I have tried a lot of different face washes and this one is definitely not my favorite. It’s difficult to get a good lather on it. I’m not a fan of the fragrance. And worst of all, it fails to wash off all my eye makeup. There was have several times I notice some mascara left behind around my eyes (and I don’t use waterproof). I will finish the bottle but not reorder it. The value is just not great for the price.

avis.titre: 4.5 Stars for A Fruity Citrus Scented Facial Cleanser That's A Bit Pricy4.5 Stars for A Fruity Citrus Scented Facial Cle
avis.texte: I got this for my Girlfriend to try to see if it can help her deal with her Lupus flare-ups. Lupus can cause all sorts of problems with facial rashes and she therefore deals with non-stop skin issues. She needs something that will help nourish the skin on her face hopefully reducing the effects from future flare-ups. I realized that Oak Essentials does not make any claims that it will help people with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus or (SLE). At first she found it an invigorating cleanser to remove her makeup and the creams she applies to reduce the rashes. In the end, it worked ok for a few times but after a full month of use, there was no helping her rashes. She likes the feel of it and the fruity citrus smell and stated it did do a good job cleaning her face and pores. But the ongoing cost would present a concern especially when she has a lot of medical expenses. She only uses a little bit at a time. Its sort of difficult to conclude a rating for this product but based on her feedback its definitely a 4.5 star rating. The product cost knocked it down half a star.

avis.titre: Gentle spa like cleansing at home
avis.texte: I love how this gel face wash creates a silky lather that leaves my skin feeling incredibly clean and hydrated without any tightness. The natural botanical scent makes my morning routine feel like a high end spa experience, while the minimalist glass bottle looks beautiful on my counter. While it is certainly a luxury investment for a cleanser, a tiny amount goes a long way and the soothing ingredients like aloe have been wonderful for my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Glowing, nurtured, cleansed skin wrapped in a spa-like experienceGlowing, nurtured, cleansed skin wrapped in a spa-like
avis.texte: Oak Essentials Pure Gel Cleanser is a luxuriously packaged gel cleanser that checks a lot of boxes with its hydrating, emollient, brightening and calming ingredients. The packaging is elegant with a weighty feel. There is 5 fluid ounces of cleanser in the bottle I received and the packaging weighs twice that (approximately 15 ounces total including product). The bottle has a matte finish that makes it easy to grip. The dispenser pump twists and locks. I plan to depot the cleanser for travel due to the weightiness of the bottle. After cleansing, I found that my skin has a natural hydrated glow, felt nurtured and my redness reduced. I have dry, dehydrated mature skin and I found 2 full pumps works best for me as I enjoy the ritual of taking the day off starting with my cleanser. I prefer to pump my cleansers into my palm, add water, and rub my hands together vigorously to create a micro-foam lather and then apply to my dampened skin. I used the cleanser a few different ways, as my second step in a double cleanse and as a stand-alone cleanse when all I had on was skincare and sunscreen. If you are sensitive to Niacinamide, this cleanser may not be for you. I also detect the slightest mild natural spa-like scent which fades upon rinse off and does not bother my skin. I do have sensitive eyes and this cleanser is so gentle it does not burn or irritate my eyes. Overall, I would highly recommend and will order this cleanser again. I have really been enjoying using Oak Essentials Pure Gel Cleanser daily for a couple of weeks now. This product gives you a spa-like experience with its luxurious feel and enticing light citrus scent. It is a true gel that feels silky smooth as you work it into a creamy lather. I like to let it stay on my face for a bit and let it really sink in before rinsing. It rinses off easily and completely and doesn't leave any makeup residue or stickiness behind. Only fresh, clean, hydrated skin. I'm in my late 50's and this product definitely helps eliminate dry spots, evens skin tone and brightens with consistent use. While it does help alleviate dryness, I still need to follow up with a serum or moisturizer. I love that Oak Essentials is made in the USA, uses zero sulfates and parabens, contains anti-aging ingredients like niacinamide, pro-vitamins and amino acids, and incorporates skin calming ingredients like aloe leaf, too. I did not experience any adverse reactions to this cleanser, redness, flaking or breakouts. It comes in a 5 oz pump bottle which makes the product easy to dispense. It's a bit pricey, but very high quality and a little of the gel goes a long way. I would highly recommend it if you are looking for a natural and effective cleanser to add to your skincare routine.

avis.titre: Great Ingredients, Great ExperienceGreat Ingredients, Great Experience
avis.texte: First, let me chase the elephant out of the room. I’m a guy and I know this cleanser is marketing to women, perhaps with the benefit of removing all the stuff gals put on in the morning…or maybe evening if it’s the weekend. But guys like clean faces too and I especially like cleansers that don’t have a lot of yukky chemicals like sulfates, sulfites, parabens and whatnot. The thought of that stuff entering my pores is an awful one. So, when I was offered to try Oak Essentials cleanser, how could I resist? I know women probably don’t want a man’s input here. And, true, I can’t relate to how well it removes makeup. But I can say this stuff is quite refreshing and I get why it has a premium price. It’s more than just it’s “better for you” ingredients. It cleans with none of the sticky residue my usual face wash leaves. I even look forward to using when I need a face wash even though it does have a bit of, let’s say, an unmasculine scent. It’s pleasant, but not one I want to bring to poker night. I doubt I’ll buy this for myself when I run out just because of the scent, but I will be buying it for all the ladies in my family because I’m pretty sure they’ll enjoy it even more than I have. Plus, I’ll continue to enjoy the softer skin I’ve noticed on better half after she uses it.

avis.titre: Beautiful bottle and packaging, but I’m not blown away by results
avis.texte: The first thing I noticed about this product was the amazing packaging and bottle. It’s glass, and very durable. The lid is plastic, but the bottle itself is heavy and sturdy. I dropped it accidentally and was worried it would be cracked, but it was totally fine! I was impressed. The product itself is nice, the consistency is thick and although the directions say to use more than one pump I’ve found just one is sufficient. It will last a long time because a little goes a long way. I have fairly tolerable skin, not super sensitive but heavy products or super stripping products will either give me a small breakout or make my skin really dry. This has done neither which is great. It smells clean, the ingredients haven’t been harsh at all, however I haven’t been blown away or anything. It removes makeup, it feels nice, but the price does seem a bit steep for the results I’m getting. It just hasn’t been amazing enough where I’d feel like the increased price was reason to switch from something else I love and have used for a long time. I’ll continue to use this until it’s gone, for sure, but I don’t think I’d purchase again. I’ll update my review if anything changes, but for now I’m happy with it but not blown away. Still four stars because it does feel like a quality product.

First of all the packaging of this is high-end luxe. It is weighty in the hand and feels like something used in a spa. A little goes a long way when I use it and it leaves my skin feeling so clean and smooth and cared for. The product smells clean and fresh. I love it and will purchase again when this bottle is empty. A +++

The bottle alone makes this cleanser a standout. The heavy opaque glass and the locking pump top that works flawlessly and dispenses an appropriate amount of product puts this is a different league than most other cleansers. For this reason it’d make a gorgeous gift and leave a great impression. The cleanser itself is a clear gel with a botanical scent due to some essential oils. I got a nice lather using a “bubble bag” to work the gel. It cleaned my skin and left it feeling soft without being harsh or drying. I will say that I find their milk cleanser a bit more moisturizing and I love the feel of its creamy consistency but that’s just personal preference. This gel is the same high quality product and doesn’t leave my dry skin feeling tight or as if my barrier has been damaged. Just the opposite in fact. The ingredients in this are “clean” and high quality. If you’re looking for an effective cleanser free from unwanted chemicals or unnecessary additives this is a great choice. It also looks fantastic on the countertop and is made in the USA. The bottle is quite large and although it is more expensive than your average ordinary cleanser nothing about this is average or ordinary! It’ll last for months making it a very reasonable investment over time.

avis.titre: Good deep cleaning product that smells great
avis.texte: This Oak Essentials Pure Gel Cleanser has been so great on my aging skin. This cleans my face so well without over drying my skin. I absolutely love the lavender scent of this product and I am someone who is normally sensitive to scented products but have had no issues with this face wash. The bottle is huge (5.8 oz) and is a beautiful glass bottle with nice pump. You do not need much of this product to cover your face so it should last me a long time making it a great value for my money. I have sensitive skin and haven’t had any bad reactions after using this product for the last week. I am so happy this product is made in the USA. This product is great if you need a cleanser to really deep clean your face after wearing makeup especially. Highly recommended!
Great if you’re looking for light cleanser nothing too thick! Smells amazing!

This cleanser feels like a professional-grade product. The packaging is sleek, generously sized, and the pump dispenser makes it easy to use without waste. The gel has a light, refreshing scent and works into a soft lather that feels very gentle on the skin, yet it still delivers a deep, thorough clean. After rinsing, my skin feels smooth, refreshed, and balanced—never tight or dry. I also appreciate the thoughtful ingredients, like aloe and Pro Vitamin B5, which help calm and hydrate while cleansing. It’s a great everyday cleanser that strikes the perfect balance between being effective and soothing. Overall, it feels both luxurious and reliable—definitely one I look forward to reaching for in my routine.

This is the best cleanser I have used in a very long time! The cleanser gel is thick and smooth, lathers nicely, and feels great on the skin. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean with no dryness or irritation. The size is great, a much larger bottle than I was expecting. I'm very pleased with this purchase!

avis.titre: Love the natural scent! High quality product
avis.texte: The cleanser is really lovely! I think my favorite thing is the scent. I normally am sensitive to most scented items but this cleanser is made with essential oils so the scent comes across very natural. It is very calming from the hints of lavender as well. The bottle is substantial and heavier than I expected. It’s a very nice quality opaque glass bottle. The lid pops on and off very smoothly. Definitely a high end product and the cleanser inside is no exception. The gel comes out perfectly. I use about2 pumps each time I wash my face. Since it is a gel it definitely needs to be lathered up with water quite a bit. I find that this gel works very well. It removes my makeup. It makes my face feel amazing, clean and soft and smooth. I love using this oak essentials gel cleanser. Super happy to have found it and yet I would Absolutely recommend it.

This cleanser is amazing. It is a thick gel and feels really nice to lather into the skin. My skin feels very soft after use I haven’t had any breakouts as of late. The scent is very natural and even the container feels high quality - it’s a ceramic bottle. While this is a pricy pick, I think it’s worth it honestly.

Absolutely love this cleanser. Smells amazing, foams up really nicely and cleanses the face well without stripping it. Comes in a really attractive and high quality upscale heavy bottle. I love this and will definitely be purchasing it in the future.
